title: Klippo Master Product-Specific Video Prompt Library
usage_notes: All curated prompt templates are stored in this version-controlled GitHub JSON library and loaded by Klippo; templates are not invented randomly at runtime.
Prompt generation is text-only. No uploaded image or AI image analysis is used. Product subtype and category are inferred from words in the supplied product name.
Each product subtype has its own shot direction and prompt template. The user may choose another concept in the same category.
No on-screen text, captions, added logos or watermarks. Default prompt duration is exactly 10 seconds, vertical 9:16.
Templates avoid unsupported specifications, benefits, ingredients, materials, accessories and performance claims.
External video generators may interpret prompts differently; Klippo stores and selects prompts but does not guarantee the output of external generators.
